meta.description: Registry for bounded locally unique selection conditions and candidate modes in Phase 3.

local_uniqueness_entries.name: Local Selection Uniqueness
local_uniqueness_entries.purpose: Represent bounded locally unique selection behavior across admissibility-sensitive recursive continuation structures.

local_uniqueness_conditions.name: local_selection_uniqueness_regions_detectable
local_uniqueness_conditions.description: The system must maintain formal predicates for identifying process sub-domains where selection metrics yield unique minima.

local_uniqueness_conditions.name: degenerate_minima_boundaries_preserved
local_uniqueness_conditions.description: Local uniqueness must not be enforced by suppressing or merging distinct degenerate minima.

local_uniqueness_conditions.name: orientation_sensitive_tie_resolution_remains_bounded
local_uniqueness_conditions.description: Weighting rules used to resolve local ties must not lead to divergent orientation drift.

local_uniqueness_conditions.name: selection_does_not_force_global_uniqueness
local_uniqueness_conditions.description: Achievement of local uniqueness does not imply the existence of a unique global continuation path.

local_uniqueness_conditions.name: recursive_selection_updates_remain_admissible
local_uniqueness_conditions.description: Each step in the recursive unique-selection sequence must satisfy current admissibility windows.

local_uniqueness_conditions.name: branch_pruning_preserves_required_uniqueness_witness
local_uniqueness_conditions.description: Pruning of non-unique branches must not eliminate all admissible continuations.

local_uniqueness_conditions.name: transport_coupled_selection_drift_remains_detectable
local_uniqueness_conditions.description: Drift in local selection rules triggered by transport must be formally registerable.

local_uniqueness_conditions.name: local_uniqueness_instability_detectable
local_uniqueness_conditions.description: Formal mechanisms must exist to detect and register the breakdown of local uniqueness into degeneracy.
